label: Exploratory; not a test of H1-H10. Tier L: the 23 non-development seen creators, run once with no split. Cue counts: sense not resolved, precision unknown (no reader). Model-coded labels, not checked by a person; agreement, never accuracy.
reading: 15 layer pairs computed; none outside both the fixed-margin (curveball) null and the placebo band, overall or in any audience or economy stratum. P000 (r4-P27's fusion test) not computed until r3-P54; its predictions not scored. P001 thin.
agnosticism: No measure in this study can tell whether a non-human source speaks; every measure describes the speech in these recordings and how the creators present it.
